channel.title: OmniSource Updates
channel.description: OmniSource is a curated, automatically maintained AltStore-compatible iOS app source. Every entry is resolved from the app's own official upstream project - GitHub Releases or the developer's official AltStore feed - and each download link is re-verified automatically.

item.title: YTKACE v21.38.3
item.description:
YouTube 21.38.3 | YTKACE 1.1.0 | YTKACE_1.1.0_YouTube_21.38.3
by @itzzace0
What's new: • Updated to YouTube 21.38.3 • Redesigned the YTKACE library player with a floating mini player, PiP and YouTube style controls • SponsorBlock now skips segments in downloaded videos • New Download Method option with Direct downloads • Modify YouTube's video zoom • Keep Shorts in Subscriptions • Option to disable PiP for Shorts • Speed menu button • Options to disable HDR, remove 1080p Premium and set a separate Shorts speed • Layout mode option • Choose the subtitle language for downloads
Fixed: • PiP not working for music videos • Gap left by hidden comment guidelines, topic chips and community posts • Download and queue buttons on older YouTube versions • Autoplay in queues • Improved Playback Fix and download retrying

YouTube 21.38.3 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs: • `YTKACE_1.1.0_YouTube_21.38.3.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer • `YTKACE_1.1.0_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16

item.title: SpotiFLAC Mobile v5.0.5
item.description:
SpotiFLAC 5.0.5 | SpotiFLAC-v5.0.5-ios-unsigned
### New Features
- **player**: Animate circular feedback on transport buttons - **albums**: Show formatted editorial descriptions - **player**: Add Mornye media notification controls - **lyrics**: Animate live previews while scrubbing playback - **lyrics**: Add countdown dots for instrumental breaks - **lyrics**: Add subtle lift to sustained word highlights - **metadata**: Remove ReplayGain from individual and selected tracks - **lyrics**: Show songwriter and provider credits after lyrics - **concerts**: Show artwork-themed event details in app - **player**: Add native audio output controls - **artists**: Show provider-neutral upcoming concerts - **lyrics**: Animate pronunciation and translation visibility - **widgets**: Add native Android and iOS home screen players - **navigation**: Refine translucent bottom bar and search folding - **player**: Animate artwork transitions and immersive lyrics - **player**: Expand compact track action menus - **library**: Show saved animated artwork on local albums - **library**: Refine album and artist artwork headers - **player**: Scroll overflowing mini player titles and artists
### Bug Fixes
- **lyrics**: Slow instrumental dot pulse - **metadata**: Restore cover artwork autofill - **lyrics**: Pulse instrumental dots in unison - **player**: Preserve lyrics state while switching to queue - **player**: Match paused cover size during panel transitions - **lyrics**: Pulse instrumental countdown dots - **lyrics**: Smooth highlight lift and keep romanization still - **android**: Bundle Discord SDK in local and CI releases - **ui**: Correct glass shader coordinates on scaled tablets - **lyrics**: Keep focus fixed when player controls hide - Adapt Hi-Res analysis card to Mornye and clarify results - Avoid inferring Hi-Res upsampling from bandwidth alone - **ui**: Shorten ReplayGain removal selection labels - **lyrics**: Align pronunciation phrases and improve readability - **ui**: Allow landscape only in the full player - **android**: Avoid blocked statx probes on legacy ARM32 devices - **ci**: Require verified V1 V2 V3 release APK signatures - **lyrics**: Soften landscape footer and use neutral tab colors - **lyrics**: Hide controls after five seconds only during playback - **player**: Move track header with the cover between panels - **artists**: Tighten concert badge and logo spacing - **concerts**: Follow the selected light or dark theme - **settings**: Remove extension row icons and correct online colors - **player**: Preserve playlist context when playing a track - **library**: Keep album batch actions alive after selection closes - **artwork**: Preserve cover colors and readable player contrast - **ios**: Adopt the UIScene lifecycle required on iOS 27 by [@BartolomeoRusso9](https://github.com/BartolomeoRusso9) - **player**: Loop marquee forward with longer reading pauses
### Refactoring
- **discord**: Remove rich presence and bundled SDK
### Styling
- Slim down the upcoming concerts badge - Simplify track metadata card headings - **player**: Reduce paused play glyph without shifting controls - **loading**: Match the compact artist header spacing - **lyrics**: Use compact liquid glass language menu - **settings**: Simplify grouped rows and use green switches
### Testing
- **l10n**: Match Indonesian tutorial terminology
### Dependencies
- **deps**: Update Flutter Rust and Android dependencies
### Chores
- **release**: Bump app version to 5.0.5 - **git**: Ignore Swift package build artifacts - **release**: Bump app version to 5.0.1+153 - Update AltStore source to v5.0.0 by [@github-actions[bot]](https://github.com/github-actions[bot])
### Build
- **android**: Enable all release APK signing schemes
### New Contributors * @BartolomeoRusso9 made their first contribution
**Full Changelog**: [v5.0.0...v5.0.5](https://github.com/spotiflacapp/SpotiFLAC-Mobile/compare/v5.0.0...v5.0.5)
---
### Downloads
#### Android - **arm64**: `SpotiFLAC-v5.0.5-arm64.apk` (recommended for modern devices) - **arm32**: `SpotiFLAC-v5.0.5-arm32.apk` (older devices)
#### iOS - **iOS**: `SpotiFLAC-v5.0.5-ios-unsigned.ipa` (sideload required)
### Installation **Android**: Enable "Install from unknown sources" and install the APK **iOS**: Use AltStore, Sideloadly, or similar tools to sideload the IPA

item.title: Apollo v3.8.0
item.description:
Apollo 3.8.0 | Apollo-Reborn-3.8.0
### Features
- Add **Save All Media** to save every image, GIF, and video in a Reddit gallery, Imgur album, or ImageChest post at once, from the fullscreen viewer's menus or an album's long-press menu, with a progress ring and Cancel (#1048: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Fullscreen images offer Save Image next to Share, and holding an image in the viewer or a feed gallery offers Copy Image and Save Image for that image instead of jumping straight to the share sheet - Also fixes **Download Video** when only Reddit's copy is available, **Save GIF** in the share sheet, and missing post controls on albums opened from a link in a post - Add **Action Menus** (Interface → Menus) to reorder and hide the actions in Apollo's ••• menus and, for moderators, its moderator menus, one menu at a time with a live preview (#1131: @icpryde) - Redesign the **Account Switcher** as a themed bottom sheet with larger avatars, Add Account and Edit at the top, and drag-to-reorder that no longer refreshes your feed (#1077: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Also fixes a crash when switching accounts - Add **Automatic Backups** (Data → Backup Settings) — pick a folder in Files and your settings are backed up there every day, three days, or seven days, keeping the ten most recent automatic backups (#1060, #1148, #1152: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Backups now save as `.apollobackup` files with the Apollo icon, and opening one from Files asks before restoring; existing `.zip` backups still restore - Add **Settings Shortcuts** — press and hold the Settings tab to jump straight to up to 15 settings pages, chosen and reordered under Interface → Tab Bar → Settings Shortcuts (#1150: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Add a **Return Button** that appears beside Back after a status-bar tap takes you to the top; tap it, or the status bar again, to jump back to where you were reading, now on Liquid Glass too (#1116: @icpryde, @IllIIllIllIllII) - Turn the button off under Interface → Display & Navigation; the second status-bar tap keeps working either way - Rework **Hidden & Deleted** into a profile row that opens one combined feed of archived posts and comments, labeled Hidden, Removed, or Deleted, with inline images and swipeable albums (#1137: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Add **Profile Picture Shape** (Interface → Display & Navigation) to show profile pictures as Full, Circle, or rounded Square across posts, comments, messages, the profile tab, and the Account Switcher (#1136: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Extend **Immersive** profile artwork behind the status and navigation bars with a wider crop and smoother fade, and long-press a profile banner to view it fullscreen and save it (#1186: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Play GIF and video tiles silently in **Gallery View**'s grid while they're on screen, with separate **Play Videos in Gallery View** and **Play GIFs in Gallery View** switches (Media → Browsing, on by default) (#1142: @icpryde) - Speed up opening and closing **images and albums** — albums zoom straight out of the feed thumbnail like single images, the background fades as you swipe media away, and closing an album returns the feed carousel to the last image you viewed (#1143: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Smooth out scrolling through **video-heavy feeds** — playing videos take far less of the app's time, and the new **Smoother Video Scrolling** switch (Posts & Feeds → Feed, on by default) prepares players in the background and lets video posts draw without stalling the scroll (#1168: @icpryde) - Keep unsent **Chat** drafts in modern Direct Chat, saved per account and conversation and restored when you come back (#1207: @Thetromboneman1) - Add **Swipe Tab Bar to Navigate** (Interface → Tab Bar, Liquid Glass, off by default) to swipe the tab bar back and forward again in place of the native drag-to-switch-tabs gesture; takes effect after relaunching (#1075: @DeltAndy123) - Add **Confirm Favorite Changes** (Subreddits → Favorites, off by default) so the star on the Subreddits list asks before adding or removing a favorite (#1173: @nunoo)
### Fixes
- Fix a **startup crash loop** after adding an account while Reddit is rate-limiting; an unexpected listing response now fails like any other load (#1147: @icpryde) - Fix a crash on launch or when switching accounts after changing your **Reddit password**; Apollo now tries to recover the expired session and asks you to sign in again if it can't (#1200: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Fix crashes loading older comments in **Live Update** mode and choosing Open in Safari on a shared GIF or other downloaded media (#1171: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Fix a crash when touching and holding a post while the feed scrolls (#1193: @icpryde) - Fix a crash tapping **Cancel** on a subreddit search with results on non-Liquid-Glass builds (#1133: @icpryde) - Bring back **Copy with Account** in Copy Widget Setup Code, lost in 3.7.1, so Home and multireddit widgets can use your account again (#1195: @icpryde) - Fix **Gallery View** hiding its first row of tiles under the navigation bar since 3.7.1, and its spinner staying up after changing the filter while it loads (#1140, #1194: @icpryde) - Holding a video in the viewer opens Save/Share without letting go, and dragging down with that sheet open no longer leaves the viewer black and unresponsive - Fix the Liquid Glass **feed search bar** springing back open after you scroll it away, staying pinned when you scroll right after cancelling a search, and the Hard header style cutting off the top of the field (#1130, #1146: @icpryde) - Collapsing a comment no longer jumps the thread or flashes a band across the top, Find in Comments swaps its buttons smoothly, and a cancelled swipe-back keeps the search field's glass - Keep the **Settings** search field below the title while searching on Liquid Glass instead of sliding up over it (#1156: @icpryde) - Make **Apollo Reborn settings** follow Apollo's Text Size and match the native rows' font weight and text colors, including the softer gray in Pure Black mode (#1165: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Fix Apollo Reborn settings screens stuttering or refusing to scroll back up, footer text drawing over the rows above it, and the list shifting after a swipe back (#1170: @icpryde) - Soften the **row highlight** when you tap a row — stock themes use Apollo's original gray again and custom themes a lighter tint of their accent (#1166: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Fix **subreddit list editing** — favorite stars stay aligned, long names stop short of the star, confirmation buttons stay tappable, rows no longer stay highlighted, and removals animate smoothly (#1174: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Keep the header visible while editing the subreddit list with **Hide Header on Scroll** on, and bring the header and tab bar back as soon as you tap the status bar (#1120: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Fix a brief stall when scrolling back down right after reaching the top of a post, and a stutter where Hide Header on Scroll kept hiding and revealing the header (#1119: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Make the **Posts** tab scroll to the top and then go back on profiles, trophies, multireddits, and posts opened from a profile, like it does on feeds (#1153: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Fix a cancelled forward swipe erasing your navigation history, so swiping forward again reopens the page (#1128: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Reopen **Floating Post Tabs** on the comment sort you left them on, Live Update included, instead of the default sort (#1125: @icpryde) - Fade a newly **posted comment** into the thread with its avatar and flair already in place, instead of the thread jumping and the avatar popping in afterwards (#1196: @icpryde) - Fix collapsing a comment thread sliding its replies down before the comments below move up (#1180: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Keep the **comment age** visible next to long usernames, which now truncate instead (#1162: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Keep recovered **deleted comments** readable when Apollo switches between light and dark mode while the thread is open (#1206: @Thetromboneman1) - Fix feed usernames drifting right…

item.title: Zeus v13.2.2
item.description: Zeus 13.2.2 | zeus-v13.2.2 > [!WARNING] > **iOS users running ZEUS on more than one device are advised to read the warning below!** ## v13.2.2 Highlights: - Embedded LND v0.21.3-beta - Swaps: SATS Routing (new default) and Coinos added as providers - iOS: automatic cleanup of stale iCloud Keychain wallet data (**see note below**) - Nostr Wallet Connect: view connection secrets after creation, stricter connection string validation - Cashu: P2PK locked token fixes - LND: imported account receive fixes - Seed recovery: catch typos before restoring - Channel migration export when the node won't start - Further security hardening measures - Miscellaneous bug fixes - Miscellaneous UI improvements > [!WARNING] > ### iOS users running ZEUS on more than one device > > Due to a bug in a third-party dependency, older versions of ZEUS unintentionally stored wallet data (including seeds and connection credentials) in the iCloud-synced keychain rather than in device-only storage. iCloud Keychain is end-to-end encrypted: the data was only readable by your own trusted devices, not by Apple or anyone else, and we have no indication that any user data was exposed. It did, however, have unintended side effects, such as stale or deleted wallet data reappearing on new or restored devices signed into the same Apple ID. It also ran against our principle that seeds should never leave your device. This release moves that data into device-local storage and then **automatically and permanently deletes the iCloud-synced copies**. No prompt is shown. > > If iCloud Keychain is enabled, that deletion propagates to every device signed into the same Apple ID. The first device you open on v13.2.2 keeps a local copy of everything and then removes the iCloud copies. **Any other device that has not yet been opened on v13.2.2 will lose its saved wallet configurations**, because older versions kept that data only in the synced keychain and had no separate on-device copy. This applies whether that device is still on an older version or has only auto-updated in the background. Because whichever device opens first performs the cleanup, no update order avoids this. Devices with iCloud Keychain turned off are not affected. > > **Before updating, on each device:** > - Make sure you have your seed phrase backed up for every embedded wallet (and your Cashu seed, if you use ecash) > - Export your wallet configurations via `Menu` > `Tools` > `Export/Import Wallet Configurations` > > **If a device loses its wallets:** your funds are not affected. Restore from your seed phrase, or import a wallet configuration export. The first device you opened on v13.2.2 still holds all of the data and can produce that export. > > Going forward, ZEUS wallet data will no longer appear automatically on new devices signed into your Apple ID. That behavior was never an intended feature, and embedded node wallets never transferred correctly through it. Single-device and Android users are not affected. ## What's Changed * chore(deps): bump js-yaml from 3.14.2 to 3.15.0 in /zeus_modules/@lightninglabs/lnc-core by @dependabot[bot] in item.title: SpotiFLAC Mobile v5.0.0
item.description:
SpotiFLAC 5.0.0 | SpotiFLAC-v5.0.0-ios-unsigned
### New Features
- **onboarding**: Add theme-aware 5.0 upgrade introduction - **library**: Add Mornye browsing and contextual compact navigation - **home**: Add large featured cards for extension feeds - **mornye**: Separate Search into a circular navigation button - **profile**: Add local profiles with backup and restore - **player**: Add beat-matched AutoMix and refine Mornye navigation - **artists**: Add branded headers and incremental release loading - **mornye**: Cache motion covers and refine player and search - **ui**: Add Mornye glass theme and adaptive music player - Add opt-in Discord Rich Presence on Android - **metadata**: Display saved ReplayGain values and refresh after analysis - **backend**: Migrate production backend to Rust - **backup**: Allow selecting categories and settings-only backups
### Bug Fixes
- **ci**: Audit stripped iOS archives and configure FFmpeg tests - Retry verification browser launch and failed searches - Sync lyric romanization and clear stale selection menus - **mornye**: Show track summary and update welcome branding - **metadata**: Remove nested barcode card background - **mornye**: Preserve icon meaning and use consistent settings accents - **settings**: Simplify player copy and add glass library info card - **ui**: Resolve album titles and show Home explicit badges - **ui**: Align local lyrics and refine Mornye selection - **player**: Preserve offline motion artwork and smooth cover changes - **ios**: Keep release feed bundle identity in sync - **android**: Validate native metadata editor results - Preserve source artist credits when downloading - **library**: Reset checkpoints and artwork on forced full scans - **metadata**: Read tags and covers from MP4 files named opus - **library**: Preserve cached covers across directory aliases - **download**: Log provider failures before fallback - **extensions**: Restore URL globals for provider link resolution - **download**: Preserve filenames after automatic SAF conversion - **backup**: Allow selecting SFLB archives for restore
### Performance
- **rust**: Stream discarded FLAC artwork during replacement - **extensions**: Avoid copying unwrapped Base64 input - **bridge**: Reduce metadata copies and decode large JSON off the UI isolate - **analysis**: Reuse sorted spectral percentile windows - **audio**: Share the Opus artwork metadata buffer - **search**: Release derived caches when track results change - **library**: Dispose unused playback row subscriptions - **metadata**: Move normalized Rust values into response envelopes - **rust**: Reduce peak allocations when resizing cover artwork - **mornye**: Reuse exact luminance contributions for contrast sampling - **mornye**: Release outgoing artwork decoders when replaced - **player**: Scope position and contrast rebuilds to controls - **extensions**: Collect unreachable JavaScript cycles after idle bursts - **images**: Decode local covers to their fitted display size - **extensions**: Share retained source text across manager and VMs - **extensions**: Reuse owned UTF-8 buffers at text boundaries - **metadata**: Preserve typed values across the Rust extension bridge - **extensions**: Validate JSON without allocating argument trees - **cue**: Parse SAF previews without copying audio - **android**: Batch SAF library recovery metadata queries - **library**: Batch album deletion and refresh once - **android**: Batch SAF lookups during download publication - **downloads**: Log finalization stage durations - **audio**: Validate FLAC remuxes before encoder fallback - **downloads**: Reuse lyrics supplied by the backend - **downloads**: Reuse HTTP connections between tracks - **lyrics**: Stream MP3 audio when updating ID3 lyrics - **analysis**: Serialize and cancel owned FFmpeg sessions - **backup**: Move archive processing off the UI isolate - **player**: Commit seek gestures once after scrubbing - **ui**: Pause motion headers when collapsed - **theme**: Bound cover palette decoding and coalesce requests - **rust**: Skip audio rewrites for identical FLAC metadata
### Refactoring
- **ui**: Unify theme styling and enlarge profile button
### Styling

### Chores
- **rust**: Update crypto, network and UniFFI dependencies - **android**: Update native dependencies and build tooling - **analyzer**: Exclude archived internal sources - **release**: Set app version to 5.0.0+152 - Update AltStore source to v4.9.6 by [@github-actions[bot]](https://github.com/github-actions[bot])

item.description:

The [install guide](https://github.com/yuroyami/syncplay-mobile/wiki/How-to-install-the-app-on-iOS) covers both. | 85 MB | ## Changelog
Everything since v0.24.0. Click to unfold. ### 0.25.0 - Audio files can be picked and played, not only video. - Music gets a picture. KitePlayer draws the sound while an audio file plays, and the drawing follows the song. A switch in the room's player settings turns it off. - The drawing changes with the music on its own, or you pick one yourself from the pattern row. - A remote reaches every control in the room and on Home, so the app works on Android TV. - Where Android TV offers no file picker, the app lists the videos on the device instead. - An invite link now opens a web page that hands you into the room, so a friend without the app still lands somewhere useful. - The room's side panels are one thing now, with one set of controls and one place they open from. - Chat colours are yours to set, and an event line colours the names it mentions. - A long press on a GIF keeps it or copies its link, and a long press on a message copies it. - Messages arriving over the video fade after a moment, and new ones are marked. - The GIF and sticker controls share one row, so results get more space, and sending one clears its search text from the chat input. - The shared playlist reorders by dragging a row, and offers your list back after a dropout. - Every track says what it is, and a video track can be selected. - Android mpv comes prebuilt from libmpvKt, which also fixed its video track selection. - iOS holds the screen on through every room entry and through a switch between players. - iOS VLC reads its clock from the engine, so a stalled notification no longer freezes the seek bar or pulls the room backward. - Rapid seeks keep the newest room update, and a replacement file no longer inherits an unfinished seek gesture. - iOS VLC finishes its seeks in Picture-in-Picture, and watching alone offers your saved position again. - Home says what each player is and what it can do. - A join link is accepted only when it is ours, and a port outside 1 to 65535 is refused with a reason. - A screen reader reaches the join form. - The ExoPlayer-only APK can be rebuilt from source and compared with the published file, so IzzyOnDroid can verify what it ships.
## Dependencies
The main ones: toolchain, network stack, video engines. item.title: Mangayomi v0.9.7
item.description:
Mangayomi 0.9.7 | Mangayomi-v0.9.7-ios
# What's New
## Reader
* **Reliable Resume to Saved Position** : * Reopening a chapter in continuous vertical reading now jumps directly and instantly to the page where you left off, even before all images have finished loading. * Eliminated the issue where the reader would land on a neighboring page or spinner instead of the correct saved position.
* **Smoother Zoomed Panning & Inertia** (#1021): * Dragging a zoomed page now follows your finger precisely using real movement delta instead of an accumulated offset, making panning far more responsive. * Flinging a zoomed page now carries natural momentum with a longer, smoother coast animation. * Overscrolling past the edge of a zoomed page automatically transfers the momentum to the page list scroll, allowing seamless continued scrolling without lifting your finger.
* **Fixed Grey Screen in Double-Page Mode**: * Chapter transition pages in vertical double-page reading no longer cause a crash or a blank grey screen when the spread is reached.
* **Reader Bottom Bar Positioning**: * The page slider and quick-action bar now correctly sit above the system gesture area and home indicator on all devices, preventing them from being hidden behind system UI.
* **Novel Reader Performance**: * Page swipes in paged novel mode no longer trigger a full rebuild of the reader tree, making navigation between pages considerably faster.
---
## Fixes & Stability
* Fixed infinite loading spinner when resuming a continuous vertical chapter mid-chapter. * Corrected the visible range check that was preventing the initial scroll anchor from being applied reliably. * Page image load events now correctly trigger a re-jump to the saved position if the list had not yet settled on the right page.
---
